answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the nebula until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the comet of the next round. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
